title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Amos 1: the herdsman of Tekoa and the words spoken against Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom and Ammon.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say about Amos himself?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says these are the words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa.

answers.text: He was among the herdsmen of Tekoa
He was a priest serving at Bethel
He was a scribe living in Jerusalem
He was a vineyard keeper on Carmel

questions.text: In whose reigns did Amos see these words concerning Israel?
questions.explanation: He saw them in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

answers.text: Hezekiah of Judah and Hoshea of Israel
Josiah of Judah and Jehu of Israel
Ahaz of Judah and Pekah of Israel
Uzziah of Judah and Jeroboam of Israel

questions.text: What will wither when Yahweh utters his voice from Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will roar from Zion and utter his voice from Jerusalem, the pastures of the shepherds will mourn and the top of Carmel will wither.

questions.text: What is Damascus charged with in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Damascus is charged with threshing Gilead with threshing instruments of iron.

answers.text: Burning the bones of a king into lime
Selling captives to the sons of the Greeks
Threshing Gilead with instruments of iron

questions.text: Whose palaces will the fire sent into the house of Hazael devour?
questions.explanation: God says he will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

questions.text: Where will the people of Syria go into captivity?
questions.explanation: God will break the bar of Damascus, and the people of Syria shall go into captivity to Kir.

questions.text: To whom did Gaza deliver up the whole community it carried away captive?
questions.explanation: Gaza carried away captive the whole community to deliver them up to Edom.

questions.text: Against which city does God say he will turn his hand in verse 8?
questions.explanation: He says he will turn his hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish.

questions.text: What is Edom charged with in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Edom pursued his brother with the sword, cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually.

answers.text: Pursuing his brother with the sword
Burning a whole city with fire
Robbing the temple of its silver

questions.text: What does verse 15 say will happen to the king of the children of Ammon?
questions.explanation: Their king will go into captivity, he and his princes together.

answers.text: He will die by the sword in battle
He will go into captivity with his princes
He will be handed over to Edom
He will flee away into Egypt
